Name: Hadar, King of Edom
Summary: Hadar reigned in Edom after Baal-hanan died, from the city of Pau. His wife was Mehetabel.
KeyStory: Hadar is the last king named in Edom's king list in Genesis — a different Hadar from Ishmael's son.
LifeLesson: Kingdoms rise and fall, but God's promise to Israel outlasted every throne of Edom.
